findings.checklist_item: Justify T15's novelty against existing prior art in the same registry — explicitly distinguish it from T2 (spike/probe/prototype recommendation), T3 (gap-routes-to-spike + auth preconditions), and coach-moves 1/4/9 — or fold the new behavior into those rather than adding a duplicate overlay.
evidence: T15 declared facet is 'overlay-empirical'-adjacent ('Facet ~ empirical / approach-soundness') — identical empirical facet to existing T2 in criteria_routing.json
T2 checklist key validation_planned: 'if risky, the plan already includes a spike/probe/prototype/benchmark/RED-fixture/pilot-with-metrics — else recommend the specific one'
T3 checklist key gap_routes_to_spike: 'A critical capability gap routes to a SPIKE before committing the full plan'
coach_moves.py MOVE_REGISTRY '1' spike: 'Consider a short spike to de-risk {subject} before committing the plan.'; '4' riskiest-assumption test; '9' plan the verification
The plan claims 'No existing criterion rewards front-loading those checks into a cheap local run or a manual probe' but supplies no comparison to T2/T3 to substantiate the gap
findings.finding: T15 substantially overlaps with existing, established mechanisms in the SAME plan-review registry (T2 overlay-empirical: 'the plan already includes a spike/probe/prototype/benchmark/RED-fixture/pilot-with-metrics — else recommend the specific one'; T3 overlay-feasibility: 'A critical capability gap routes to a SPIKE before committing the full plan'; and coach_moves.py moves 1 'spike'/de-risk-before-committing, 4 'riskiest-assumption test', 9 'plan the verification'), yet the plan never justifies T15's novelty vs these — the anti-repackaging / Rule-of-Three obligation is unaddressed.
findings.location: Plan section 'The finalized T15 rubric (design of record)' and motivation paragraph ('No existing criterion rewards front-loading those checks')
scenarios: A reviewer/registry maintainer approving T15 without knowing it duplicates most of T2's 'recommend the specific spike/probe' behavior, producing two overlapping advisory overlays that both fire on the same risky infra plan
The proposed 'out-of-loop-proof' coach-move being added despite moves 1/4/9 already covering de-risk/riskiest-assumption/plan-the-verification, proliferating near-duplicate moves
findings.suggested_fix: Add a short 'Distinction vs existing criteria' subsection stating precisely what T15 covers that T2/T3 do not (e.g. the PROVE-THEN-CODIFY ordering against a slow codified loop, and the scoped-cleanup obligation for throwaway experiments), and note whether the proposed coach-move differs materially from moves 1/4/9 or should reuse one of them; capture this reconciliation in the coach-move decision comment the last AC already requires.
